title: Obtaining targeted metagenomes from uncultivated environmental _Synechococcus_ using flow cytometry-based viral tagging
protocol: Prepare SNAX medium according to directions, but use ¹⁵N ammonium chloride.
Grow cyanobacteria in the prepared medium with heavy nitrogen and transfer at least three times before use.
Extract DNA from bacteria grown in heavy nitrogen using standard methods.
Quantify the extracted DNA using Quant-iT Pico Green (Invitrogen #P7589).
Use at least 10 µg of DNA for density gradient centrifugation.
Mix the DNA with TE buffer to a final volume of 0.9 ml.
Prepare CsCl in TE to a density of p1.8 and measure its density.
Mix the DNA solution with 4 ml of CsCl prepared to a density of p1.7.
Dispense 4.9 ml of the DNA-CsCl mixture into an OptiSeal tube and plug it with black caps.
Centrifuge the tubes at 44,000 rpm in a Beckman L70 or L80 ultracentrifuge for 48 hours at 18°C.
Collect fractions of 0.2-0.25 ml after centrifugation.
Measure the density of each collected fraction.
Calculate the amount of DNA in each fraction using Quant-iT Pico Green (perform in duplicate).
Estimate the ratio of isotopic labeled cells based on DNA concentration and density measurements.
Thaw 10,000x stock of SYBR Gold in the dark.
Vortex the thawed SYBR Gold vigorously.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 3000 x g.
Dilute SYBR Gold 1:100 with TE buffer.
Filter diluted SYBR Gold through a 0.02µm filter.
Aliquot filtered SYBR Gold into 50 or 100 µl amounts.
Store aliquoted SYBR Gold frozen at -20°C.
Thaw prepared 100X SYBR Gold in the dark, one time only.
Vortex thawed SYBR Gold vigorously before using to stain viruses.
If using CsCl-purified virus, dialyze in modified MTN buffer.
Add prepared SYBR Gold to viral suspension for a final concentration of 5x or 1x.
Prepare a blank without virus to assess excess dye removal.
Vortex the sample for 10 sec on high to mix dye and viruses.
Incubate the sample 10 min in the dark at room temperature.
Heat the sample at appropriate temperature for 10 min, covered with foil.
Cool down the heated sample in the dark at room temperature for 10 min.
Do not vortex the hot sample to avoid disrupting phage particles.
Prepare 0.02 μm filtered 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) in phosphate buffered saline (PBS).
Wash Nanosep 10k tubes by adding 500 µl MTN buffer, let stand for 10 minutes, then spin at 5,000 x g for 10 minutes and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μl of 0.02 μm filtered 1% BSA to Nanosep tubes, let stand for 1 hour at room temperature, then spin until almost dry (5,000 x g, 15-30 min), and discard the flow-through.
Wash with 500 µl of 0.02 μm filtered MTN buffer.
Concentrate stained virus preparations in pre-treated Nanosep devices using 3,000 x g for 15-30 minutes at 10°C to a volume less than 50 µl.
Wash the reduced volume of stained virus with 500 µl of 0.02 μm filtered MTN buffer and repeat spin as in step #6.
Repeat washing steps to achieve a total of six washes, ensuring the volume is kept under 50 µl each time.
Transfer 50 µl of washed viruses from Nanosep into fresh collection tubes (1.5 ml centrifuge tubes) and keep on ice.
Add 50 μl of 0.02 μm filtered buffer to each Nanosep.
Sonicate the Nanoseps for 3 minutes using settings of 50W at 42 kHz.
Pipette up and down carefully on the filter without puncturing the membrane.
Transfer the mixture to appropriate stained virus or blank tubes.
Transport collection tubes of washed viruses on ice.
Perform tagging as soon as possible after staining and washing the virus.
Count host cells and SYBR-stained viruses to determine amounts for addition.
Incubate washed viruses with isotope-labeled host cells at a ratio of 1:10 for 60 minutes.
Prepare the flow cytometer for use and trigger on forward angle or side scatter.
Examine 0.02 μm filtered MTN buffer to set voltages minimizing noise.
Set voltages to determine proper concentration and location of host cells on plot of 520nm vs scatter.
Use fluorescent polystyrene FLOW Check™ microspheres at a final concentration of 1:1 to host cells as an internal standard for counting and sorting.
Mix host cells with SYBR-Blank, incubate in the dark for 10 minutes.
Gently mix the tube after incubation.
Mix the host cells with the stained and washed virus at the appropriate VBR.
Examine after appropriate incubation times.
Sort and collect the viral-tagged cells which are of increased fluorescence.
Subject sorted viral-tagged cells to DNA extraction.
Separate <sup>15</sup>N-labeled “heavy” host DNA from non-labeled “light” viral DNA by CsCl density ultracentrifugation.
Linker amplify light DNA for sequencing by 454 Roche Titanium and Illumina HiSeq 2000.
